newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P affirms ELSAM ratings, downgrades outlook.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms ELSAM ratings, downgrades outlook.

text.p: U.S. ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it affirmed the AA+ long-term issuer credit rating and AA+ long-term unsecured debt rating for ELSAM I/S but revised the outlook to negative from stable.
"The outlook revision reflects the changing environment in the Danish electricity sector," Standard & Poor's said.
"Competitive pressures may potentially increase as the Danish electricity market starts to open up for large electricity consumers and distributors."

Furthermore, as a consequence of the state support for combined heat and power (CHP) stations, the proportion of power produced outside the ELSAM power pool has increased in recent years, the agency said.
But ELSAM's ownership ties, with six utility partners owned by municipal and cooperative distribution undertakings, may hold back the move towards increased competition, it said.
In addition, ELSAM's ability to pass through costs will help the consortium to maintain a strong position within its supply area, Standard & Poor's said.
